text: Long coffee with Aoife. Her mum's moving in with them end of the month while the flat gets sorted. Her brother Liam is in Galway now, works for the council. Remind me to text her the day before the move to see if she needs a hand.
Caught up with Mihai after football. Lives in Walthamstow, works nights at the depot. Wife is Teresa, two kids, the eldest just started secondary.

Kofi rang. His dad has a hip op on 14 May at the Royal Free and he's pretty anxious about it. Kofi's staying with his parents that week and his sister Nia is coming down from Glasgow to help. Their mum doesn't drive, so it's all on them. Kofi said the recovery is six weeks minimum and his dad is a terrible patient. Remind me to call him that evening, and maybe drop round a lasagne the week after.

Nia and Gareth are doing a joint fortieth on the 3rd of June, garden do at theirs. Gareth wants vinyl, has been dropping hints about a Stevie Wonder pressing. Nia said cash for the honeymoon fund they never had would be fine too lol.
Ximena works at the hospital pharmacy in Leeds. Grew up in Bogotá, sister Beatriz is in Madrid. Vegetarian, hates coriander.
Varun's interview at Arup is sometime next week. He's nervous, hasn't done one in eight years. Need to message him good luck the night before.
Picked up the dry cleaning, still need to book the MOT before 14/05.

Big catch-up with Imani and her partner Dawit over lunch. Their daughter Ava starts nursery early March, Imani's going back to work at the bank three days a week after that. Dawit's brother Bilal is over from Addis for the summer and staying in their box room. Imani seemed a bit frazzled honestly. Should check in with her the week after Ava starts.
Hoang's grandmother passed away last Thursday. Funeral is on the 28th in Birmingham. He said not to fuss but I'll send flowers to his mum's.
Sinead's hen do got called off, she and the fiancé split up a few weeks ago. She's moving back to her parents' in Cork over the summer. Don't forget to ring her this weekend.
Noor: lives in Stockport, teaches year 4, husband Rafael is a sound engineer. Two cats, Pickle and Tofu.
Met Anya's new boyfriend, Lior. Nice. He's a paramedic, from Haifa originally, lives in Hackney.
Wiremu passed his driving test!! Third attempt. Send him something daft to celebrate.
Aditi's sister Seo-yeon... no wait, that's her flatmate. Seo-yeon is the flatmate, Aditi's sister is called Eilidh? Need to double check. Anyway the flat is in Partick.

Kasia called about her dad. He's had another fall and she's flying to Kraków on 22 November to be with him for a fortnight. She's exhausted. Remind me to text her the day she lands and again the week after.
Oscar's band has a gig at the Lexington on 9th of November. I'm going with Hemi. Oscar's mum is coming down from Leeds for it too.

Lunch with Ayo. He's leaving Deloitte end of the month, starting at a tiny fintech in early December. His wife Teresa is due in January so the timing is mad. He's weirdly calm. Must get a card for the leaving drinks on the 30th. Also his brother Kofi is apparently organising a baby shower sometime in December, which Ayo is pretending not to know about. Teresa wants practical stuff, not cute outfits.
Vikram's mum turns 70 on 2 Feb. He's planning a surprise dinner and wants ideas. She loves gardening, mentioned she wants a proper kneeling bench.
Dentist moved to 11/11, 9:40.
Beatriz and Aurelio got engaged in Lisbon!! Wedding probably over the summer next year, maybe Porto. Send congrats.
Eilidh is a vet in Inverness. Her husband Gareth Murphy is a primary teacher there, they've got three boys and a collie called Bran.
Spoke with Rafael's sister Ximena at the party. She's doing a PhD in marine biology at Plymouth, finishes sometime next spring. Shy at first but loved talking about seals.
Dawit said his boss is making him redundant, meeting is 14 May. He's gutted, been there eleven years. I should take him for a pint after.

Liam and Aoife are off to Japan for three weeks from early March. Liam's never flown long haul and is dreading it. Liam's mum is minding their dog Biscuit while they're away. Aoife's mostly excited about the food and wants to do a cooking class in Kyoto. Ask them how it went when they're back, sometime late March.
Remind me to ring Mrs Popescu the week after her cataract surgery, it's 5th of December.
Gareth's daughter Nia has her grade 5 piano exam on 21/11. She's practising like mad and is a bit of a wreck. Gareth asked me to come to her recital after, which I said yes to.
Hemi's into bouldering and sourdough. Works remote for a games studio in Wellington, timezone means he's up at 5. Partner is Wiremu.
Noticed I'm low on printer ink and the gas bill is due end of the month.
Texted with Aurelio. His dad, Uncle Mihai, is selling the farm in Tuscany over the summer. Aurelio's cut up about it but understands. His cousin Teresa might buy part of it.

Bilal's starting a plumbing apprenticeship sometime next week. Proud uncle moment for Kofi, who basically talked him into it. Bilal dropped out of college last year and had a rough patch, so this is a big deal. His mum cried apparently. Kofi's buying him a proper toolbag. Text Bilal on his first day, and ask Kofi how it's going end of the month.

Catch-up call with Seo-yeon. She lives in Busan now with her husband and their two-year-old, works for Samsung in logistics. Her mum still lives in Croydon. She's coming over early March for her mum's 60th, wants to meet up while she's here. Remind me to sort a date with her the week before she flies.
Ava - Imani's little one - lost her first tooth today apparently. Massive drama.

Anya is training for the Edinburgh marathon, 24 May. Her knee's been playing up. Physio twice a week. Lior's doing the 10k on the same weekend so they're making a trip of it, staying with her aunt in Leith. Anya's worried she won't finish under four hours and keeps talking about pulling out. Message her the day before.
Varun got the Arup job! Starts 3rd of January. Send congratulations, and maybe a bottle of something.
Talked to Kasia Wang at the school gate. Her son Oscar is in Ava's class, they live on Hollins Road. She's a GP at the Moss Side practice.
Bea's (Beatriz) moving to Bristol 14 May, new job at the university. Her partner Aurelio is staying in London till the summer. Long distance for a bit. She seemed a bit down about that.
Need to call Hoang sometime next week to see how he's doing after the funeral.
Teresa mentioned Rafael's grandad is in hospital again, chest infection. Rafael's driving up to Newcastle on Friday. Remind me to text Rafael Saturday evening.
Lior and Anya's housewarming is 15th of November. They've finally got the place in Clapton. I'm bringing a plant, she said they've got nothing green.
Sinead's brother Kofi... no, Sinead's cousin is called Kofi? Whatever. Her mum is a nurse in Limerick and her dad runs a pub.

Dinner at Hemi's. Wiremu is doing a pottery course on Thursday nights until early December, wants a wheel of his own eventually. Their dog Kiri had her teeth out last week and is fine now. Hemi's brother is getting married 6th of June in Auckland, they're flying out for three weeks. I said I'd water the plants.
Aditi Sato is pregnant! Due late April. Her husband Varun is beyond excited, already building furniture. Congratulate them both properly when I see them.
Mihai's eldest, Rafael, has a trial for the county under-14s on Saturday. Mihai is more nervous than the kid. Message him Saturday afternoon to find out how it went.
Gym, shop, laundry. Need to renew passport before the end of the month.
Kofi Mensah, met through Dawit. Accountant at a housing association. Lives in Peckham with his partner and her two kids.

Long voice note from Eilidh. Her dad's diagnosis came back as early stage Parkinson's. She's taking him to a specialist on 14/11 in Aberdeen. Her brother Liam isn't coping well and has stopped answering calls. She asked if I could message Liam, which I will. Also should send Eilidh something nice, maybe that tea she likes, before the appointment. Her kids are fine, bit oblivious.
Ximena's birthday is 19 March. Loves Studio Ghibli and anything with frogs on it.
Gareth's retirement do was rescheduled from Friday to 3 December, the hall was double booked. He finishes at the fire station on the 1st.
Called Noor. Rafael's mum is visiting from Porto end of the month for a fortnight. Noor's nervous because they've only met twice and her Portuguese is terrible. Ask her the week after how it went.
Ayo's daughter Imani started at Manchester uni in September, doing law. Loves it. Ayo says she never calls home, which he's trying not to take personally.
Wedding's off for Oscar and Kasia. He didn't want to talk about it. Check in with him sometime next week, gently.
Seo-yeon's son had his tonsils out yesterday. Recovering at home, eating loads of ice cream. Her husband took the week off.
Aoife started her nursing degree at UCD. Lives in halls, her mum Sinead drops off food every Sunday.
Dr Jensen said the results should be back in early March. Nothing to do till then.

Hoang and his wife Ava are doing their tenth anniversary in Vietnam over the summer, first trip back with the kids. Hoang's dad still lives in Hue. Remind me to send them a card the week before they fly.
Bilal says his mum's had a stroke. She's in Salford Royal. He's going every evening after work. He's not sleeping. I need to call him tomorrow and drop off some food at the weekend.

Vik (Vikram) has his citizenship test on 8 December, been revising for months. Then his parents come over from Pune 20th to 4th Jan. Busy few weeks for him. Remind me to wish him luck the morning of the test.
Imani works in compliance at Barclays. Her brother Ayo lives in Lagos, her mum's in Luton. Allergic to nuts.
Rang Dawit back. His surgery went fine on Tuesday, home tomorrow. Bilal's staying with him for the first few days. Pop round with some soup end of the week.
Wiremu's mum is doing the Auckland half on 2nd of November. First race ever at 62. He's really proud.
